Your 68% match is a FAIR FIT for the Program Manager, Scale Onboarding role at Figma.

- Workshop facilitation maps to leading customer-facing sessions and webinars

**Gaps:**
- No B2B SaaS experience, which is a must-have
- Lacks the 4+ years of customer onboarding or implementation work

**Recommendation:** Apply only after gaining customer onboarding or customer success experience at a SaaS company, and in your cover letter frame your workshop facilitation and Head of Year role as managing many stakeholders at scale.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Getting a high volume of customers to a successful onboarding closeout is mostly a problem of clear teaching at scale. I've worked on it from the classroom side: I wrote my department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, so a whole team could deliver it consistently without me in the room.

I'm a Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, and my day job is close to your scale onboarding brief. I keep a year group of 210 students on track, run weekly parent calls, and explain the same idea to audiences of very different backgrounds and seniority, from teenagers to senior leadership. I track progress in Excel and Google Sheets and report results to leadership each term, which is the habit behind your metrics and customer feedback reporting. My Year 11 grade 5+ rate rose from 71% to 86% over three years. I haven't worked in B2B SaaS, but I design workshops and learning materials, I'm building my data skills (basic Python and the Google Data Analytics Certificate, in progress) and I pick up new tools quickly. Your "Grow as you go" value describes how I work.

Expanding programs for international sales teams while partnering with marketing and enablement is a challenge I'd like to help with from London. I'm available to talk at your convenience and would welcome the chance to walk you through how I'd approach it.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Program Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm a physics teacher who wrote a practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, and I run weekly parent calls and two parents' evenings a term for a year group of 210 students, so guiding many people through something new is already my daily work. That's the skill I'd bring to your scale onboarding programs, along with workshop facilitation for audiences of different ages and backgrounds. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I can start a conversation any weekday and would be glad to talk at a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
